skills.name: Thousand Tides (千汐)
skills.line: The waves bring both blessings and destruction.
skills.description: Senhime sends splashing waves to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and if Murex Halberd is present, it gains 1 layer of Sound of the Tides.

skills.name: Tidal Dream (汐夢)
skills.line: Time is meaningless in the Sea of Eternity.
skills.description:
At the end of a non-summoned enemy's turn, Senhime rides the waves to increase her move bar by 10%.
Senhime attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 172% of her ATK. If Murex Halberd is present, also inflicts them with Tidal Dream, lasts for 1 turn. ;Tidal Dream (汐夢) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Effect is consumed after taking an action and removes 3 onibi from the enemy. Does not affect monsters.

upgrades.text: If a enemy inflicted with Tidal Dream has 0 onibi after taking an action, they become inflicted with Deep Freeze (lasts for 1 turn).

skills.name: Tame the Tides (海潮入夢)
skills.line: Only the tides and songs of the merfolk are the guiding lights in the sea.
skills.description:
Senhime summons Murex Halberd to receive blessings from the tides. ; : ;Sound of the Tides (潮声) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Each time Murex Halberd gains 7 layers of Sound of the Tides, gain 3 onibi and damage dealt for all allies is permanently increased by 15%, max 5 layers. ;Murex Halberd (海貝の戟) :Immune to debuffs and controlling effects. Unable to move. Its DEF is equal to 100% of Senhime's DEF and HP is equal to 550% of her ATK.
When it is on the battlefield, it recovers the HP of an ally by 30% of the damage received. Murex Halberd has is a 50% chance of gaining 1 layer of Sound of the Tides when an ally spends an onibi. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: When Murex Halberd is present, Senhime and Murex Halberd gain 30% of damage reduction.
When Murex Halberd is present, chance of gaining 1 layer of Sound of the Tides increases to 100%.
When Senhime is wielding the Murex Halberd, she gains immunity to controlling effects and similar effects such as Banish.
When Murex Halberd is summoned, it immediately gains 3 layers of Sound of the Tides.

skills.name: Tide of Eternity (永生の汐)
skills.description:
Senhime raises Murex Halberd to direct a torrent of waves at all enemies, dealing damage equal to 120% of her ATK.
At the start of her turn, she gains 1 layer of Dirge, max 5 layers. The damage for this skill increases to 220%/320%/420%/520%/620% based on how many Dirge layers (1-5) she has.
After usage or Murex Halberd is KO'd, all layers of Dirge are removed and this skill changes to Tame the Tides.
;Dirge (悲歌)
:
:Increases damage dealt by Tide of Eternity.

bio.condition: Team Senhime with another player's Suzuka Gozen and clear any zone 10 times.
